questions.prompt: Which treaty divided the New World between Spain and Portugal?
questions.fact: The line was drawn before anyone knew what was there, which is the accident that made Brazil Portuguese.

questions.prompt: What is the pH range of an acidic solution?
questions.fact: The scale is logarithmic, so a pH of 3 is a hundred times more acidic than a pH of 5.

questions.prompt: In cricket, what is the fielding position directly behind the batter called?
questions.fact: They typically take more catches than any other fielder, and are the only player permitted gloves and pads.

questions.prompt: Which fashion designer created the little black dress in the 1920s?
questions.fact: A magazine compared it to the Ford Model T, meaning it was a uniform anyone could wear.

questions.prompt: Which African river is the second longest?
questions.fact: It crosses the equator twice, which means part of its basin is always in a rainy season.

questions.prompt: Who wrote the epic poem Paradise Lost?
questions.fact: He was completely blind by the time he composed it, dictating the lines to whoever was available.

questions.prompt: What is the term for testing software by feeding it random input?
questions.fact: It has found serious flaws in software that had passed years of careful hand-written tests.
